# Big Boys Junk Removal

> Fast, affordable junk removal across Metro Atlanta & North Georgia. Instant upfront pricing, same-day pickup, fully insured crews.

## About

Big Boys Junk Removal is a modern junk removal service operating across Metro Atlanta and North Georgia. Customers get instant, transparent pricing online: no waiting for estimates. The service covers residential and commercial junk removal with same-day availability, professional uniformed crews, and eco-friendly disposal practices.

## How It Works

1. Enter your ZIP code to confirm service availability.
2. Choose a pricing method: price by individual item or by load size.
3. Select items or estimate your load using an interactive visual tool.
4. See your exact price instantly: no hidden fees.
5. Book a pickup time. Same-day slots are often available.
6. Our crew arrives, loads everything, and cleans up.

## Services

- [Furniture Removal](/services/furniture-removal): Couches, tables, dressers, desks, chairs, bookshelves, and more.
- [Appliance Removal](/services/appliance-removal): Refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, stoves, and other household appliances.
- [Mattress Removal](/services/mattress-removal): All mattress sizes, box springs, bed frames, and headboards.
- [Hot Tub Removal](/services/hot-tub-removal): Full hot tub and spa demolition and hauling.
- [Yard Waste Removal](/services/yard-waste-removal): Branches, brush, leaves, dirt, sod, mulch, and storm debris.
- [General Junk Removal](/services/junk-removal): Household junk, garage clutter, basement cleanouts, and miscellaneous items.
- [Garage & Basement Cleanouts](/services/cleanouts): Full cleanout services for garages, basements, attics, and storage units.
- [Construction Debris Removal](/services/construction-debris): Drywall, lumber, tile, concrete, and renovation waste.

## Pricing

- **By Item**: Select individual items (50+ supported) and see per-item pricing instantly.
- **By Load Size**: Estimate your load using a visual trailer diagram for volume-based pricing.
- No hidden fees. Price shown is price paid.

## Key Features

- Instant online pricing: no phone calls or in-home estimates required
- Same-day and next-day pickup available
- Fully licensed and insured
- 4.9-star customer rating
- Eco-friendly disposal: items donated or recycled when possible
- Professional, background-checked crews
